chunks: Certainly your Lord provides with open hands whosoever He will, but according to capacity, for He knows and watches His creatures.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how Allah provides sustenance to His servants?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind the disparity in provision, reminding believers that wealth distribution is not a measure of spiritual merit but a test of gratitude and patience. It highlights Allah's 'Khabir' (All-Aware) and 'Basir' (All-Seeing) attributes, assuring that He observes both the outward circumstances and the inward intentions of His servants.
